description:
Cast Moonglove Extract by paying its mana cost.
When Moonglove Extract enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Moonglove Extract.
Activate Moonglove Extract by sacrificing it.
Haru triggers, returning Moonglove Extract from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Moonglove Extract ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
